scope: Disposable SQLite store and two barrier-started authenticated in-process API requests.
fixture_population: One API commit plus 9,998 direct synthetic inserts, then two barrier-started in-process API requests; not a load/soak benchmark.
limitations: One finite two-request race; not proof of all interleavings, distributed contention, PostgreSQL behavior, throughput, soak or physical acceptance.
sanitization: Aggregate counts/statuses/assertions only; no credentials, identities, sessions, receipts, event IDs, database files or local paths exported.
